verdict: Meta delivering steady leads; Google spend is being redirected.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 144 leads at a cost of $15.84 per lead, with Meta driving every one of them. Google Ads ran alongside Meta during this period but produced zero leads on $675.54 in spend, so that budget is being pulled back — down 27% already this week — and will be reallocated. Cost per lead crept up about 5% week-over-week as spend grew faster than lead volume, which is the immediate focus on the Meta side. New landing pages and a fresh creative batch are both scheduled to go live by August 31, which should put downward pressure on cost per lead heading into September.

watch_item.issue: A gap exists between leads received and opportunities logged in the CRM — 18 contacts are not showing as opportunities, and no appointments are recorded this period, pointing to a pipeline intake or follow-up step that may be missing leads after they arrive.
watch_item.fix: The full CRM build is scheduled complete by August 31, with an end-to-end stack re-test the same day to confirm no contacts are falling through.
